comments.label: Comment by Aurora Tarannum 37 weeks ago
comments.text: This course is very theoretical, so the key is really understanding the concepts and the physics behind them. The questions aren’t usually direct, but once you understand what he’s actually asking, they become much easier to answer. His classes can be hard to follow for most students, so taking detailed notes,writing down everything he puts on the board helps a lot. Going through class notes from previous semesters is also useful. What worked best for me though, was carefully reading his book, since his lectures closely follow it. Also he usually hints at the type of questions to expect before the midterm and final, so paying attention to that and practicing accordingly makes a big difference
